**Solution:** (a) is correct. That is the definitional split.

final.text: A shared and programmable ledger can link assets directly to owners' accounts, eliminating separate recordkeeping and stand-alone custodial services, while smart contracts can automate processes such as share auctions and key data can be embedded in the token.
Tokenized issuance mainly benefits the largest issuances, where information is scarcest in traditional markets.
Tokenized issuance eliminates all issuance costs, including underwriting risk.
Embedding data in tokens reduces transparency by restricting information to token holders.
